title: Arcadia Round Barn

services.name: Loft Rental
services.desc: With a capacity of 150 people, a competitive price and its unique round setting, the Loft lends a very special atmosphere to most any event. Tables and chairs are available and catering is welcome. The Barn may be rented for up to 12 hours and bands may set up for live music and dancing. Smoking is not allowed given the structure is made entirely of wood. There are clean restrooms on the premises as well. If you would like to extend your party or event outdoors around the exterior of the barn, we also have new picnic tables for some additional seating and lots of grass and shade trees for relaxing under. So book the Loft at the Round Barn today for your upcoming special event! Your guests
